ANSWER: NO

HALLUCINATIONS: None

The memo accurately represents that key financial terms (deal size, interest rate, maturity date, etc.) are "N/A" or not available in the source document. All factual claims in the memo are supported by the source document, including:

- The date of the agreement (October 30, 2024)
- The borrower name (Biodesix, Inc., Delaware corporation)  
- The lender/agent (Perceptive Credit Holdings IV, LP)
- The amendment history and dates
- The CFO's name (Robin Harper Cowie)
- The secured nature of the facility
- The representation of no current defaults

The memo appropriately acknowledges when information is not available rather than fabricating financial terms.

ANSWER: YES

MISSING_TERMS: 
- Original credit agreement date (November 16, 2022)
- Previous amendment dates (May 10, 2023; August 4, 2023; February 29, 2024)
- Fourth Amended and Restated Fee Letter referenced as condition precedent
- Specific lender composition (document mentions "Majority Lenders" but specific lenders not identified beyond Perceptive Credit Holdings IV, LP)
- Reference to Article 7 representations and warranties of the Credit Agreement
- Section 13.04 amendment procedures reference
- Sections 13.10 and 13.11 incorporation (Jurisdiction and Jury Trial Waiver)
- New York governing law provision
- Security interests and collateral structure details (document acknowledges liens exist but doesn't specify what assets are secured)
